regime_change_general.note: regime.json regimes.general.regime changes vs last notified

regime_change_block.note: central_bank or fiscal confirmed regime changes vs last notified

gate_withheld.note: daily_log gate pass -> fail (and recovery fail -> pass)

block_degraded.note: a block's source_health leaves 'fresh' (stale/proxy/unavailable) or returns to fresh

refresh_error.note: ingestion finished with source errors (heartbeat.errors non-empty), transition only

jefe_ranking_change.note: new jefe Friday: own position changed, or top/bottom currency changed

price_gate.note: FLOOR_FRICTION / LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY entered or left (covered by regime_change_general, listed for clarity)

suppression.note: an event fires once, on the transition; the same state on later refreshes is silent. No cooldown needed: state is persisted in data/<ccy>/notify_state.json

format.numbers: only from agent.json / regime.json / jefe.json (no computation in the notifier)
